title: Second-factor localization for arbitrary cohomology models
statement: Let $R,A,B,B_p,D$ be commutative rings, $A$ and $B$ $R$-algebras, and $B_p$ a localization of $B$ at a multiplicative submonoid $T$, with compatible maps $R\to B\to B_p$. Suppose $D$ has maps from $A\otimes_R B$ and $A\otimes_R B_p$ whose restrictions to $A$ agree and whose restrictions to $B$ agree through $B_p$. Use the complex and scalar extension conventions of [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology]. For every integer $i$, complex $Q$ of $A$-modules and base-derived tensor cohomology models $L$ over $(R,A,B)$ and $K$ over $(R,A,B_p)$ [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], there exists a family of $D$-linear isomorphisms $D\otimes_{A\otimes_R B}H_L^i\cong D\otimes_{A\otimes_R B_p}H_K^i$. This family commutes with localized comparison for every ordinary-complex identification fixing $d\otimes x$, and is natural for all counit-compatible model morphisms and cohomology maps characterized by $\mathrm{cohomologyIso}$. The base $R$ and complex $Q$ remain fixed.

proof.text: Use localization flatness from Mathlib. For each Q,L,K choose the isomorphism of exists_secondLocalization_iso; its generator characterization determines its hom uniquely by IsSecondLocalizationMap.ext. Apply secondLocalization_comparison and secondLocalization_naturality to these characterized isomorphisms, then combine the two clauses.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0DJ8 affine localization identity; split coefficient map construction, invertibility, comparison and naturality by P1

theorem derivedTensor_second_localization_models
    (T : Submonoid B) [IsLocalization T Bp] (i : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
        (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
        (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q D),
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj
            (L.cohomology i) ≅
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] Bp) D)).obj
            (K.cohomology i),
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
          (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
          (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q D)
          (τ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ≅
            ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] Bp) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] Bp)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q),
          (∀ (j : ℤ) (d : D) (x : Q.X j),
            τ.hom.f j (d ⊗ₜ[A, (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] x) =
              d ⊗ₜ[A, (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] Bp) D).comp
                (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] Bp))] x) →
          L.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i =
            (e Q L K).hom ≫ K.localizedComparison i) ∧
      (∀ (Q Q' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : Q ⟶ Q')
          (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
          (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q D)
          (L' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q' D)
          (K' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q' D)
          (δ : L.derived ⟶ L'.derived) (ε : K.derived ⟶ K'.derived)
          (g : L.cohomology i ⟶ L'.cohomology i)
          (h : K.cohomology i ⟶ K'.cohomology i),
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) δ ≫
            L'.counit = L.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map g ≫
              (L'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (L.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (L.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict R A).map f)))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (δ.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict R A).obj Q')))) →
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) ε ≫
            K'.counit = K.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : Bp →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] Bp).toRingHom).map h ≫
              (K'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (K.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} Bp) i).map
              (K.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict R A).map f)))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} Bp) i).map
              (ε.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict R A).obj Q')))) →
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).map g ≫
            (e Q' L' K').hom =
          (e Q L K).hom ≫
            (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] Bp) D)).map h)
